findings.quote: stayed informed. couldn't fix a fence.

The external caption omits the offending words, so text extraction and Markdown review do not reveal the contradiction.
findings.suggested_correction: Remove the obsolete embedded sentence from the Gary source artwork or replace it with a neutral name-only treatment. Keep the readable external caption. Rebuild and inspect every output that embeds this asset.

findings.quote: ILO, Generative AI and Jobs: A 2025 Update Good.
findings.reason: Linked source labels render in ordinary body type without punctuation or enclosure. Adjacent source titles and resumed sentences become difficult to parse. Page115 has consecutive Census labels followed immediately by Table H-5 In 2024. Functional links and valid source hashes do not test this reading problem.
findings.suggested_correction: Adopt a consistent citation treatment in the canonical source and publication transform, such as punctuated parenthetical short labels or numbered notes. Preserve targets and distinguish citations from ordinary prose links. Inspect changed pages in color and grayscale.
findings.verification: Confirmed by reading and viewing all listed pages; not a finding of absent citations or false claims.

findings.quote: The line between the people who come through this period with some footing and the people who get flattened by it is a habit
findings.reason: This attributes outcomes to a personal habit after Chapter8 carefully explains that Gary and Sal had different room to move. Chapter10 then protects rest, receiving care and nonproduction, making the categorical dividing-line claim internally at odds with its own next paragraph.
findings.suggested_correction: Keep create-over-consume as an invitation and a practical habit. For example: One habit can help you find some footing: make something another person can use. Revise both the briefing bullet and Foundations sentence, without changing Denny's earned scene.
findings.verification: Internal comparison with physical145-146 and188; no external factual judgment required.

findings.quote: Some people have already survived an automation wave. Find them. They aren't on LinkedIn.
findings.reason: The categorical exclusion of an online channel survives even though this edition deliberately permits online introductions in Chapter10, and Denny reaches displaced people online. It can send readers past useful people for no demonstrated reason.
findings.suggested_correction: Keep the first two sentences and replace the last with Ask what helped them get through the year after, or simply end at Find them.
findings.verification: Confirmed against revised human-filter instruction on p189 and Denny scene pp186-188.

findings.quote: Their own rules: target only empty vehicles
findings.reason: The table aligns this Safe Street Rebel rule with a separate crowd burning a Waymo. Row alignment can imply that the same activists broke their stated rule, though the prose and source list do not establish that attribution. Other rows also pair unlike categories rather than corresponding evidence.
findings.suggested_correction: Present the stated concerns and the documented incidents as two independent lists or subsections. State that the fire is a separate incident without attributing it to the coning group unless a checked source establishes that connection.
findings.verification: Confirmed structural implication in rendered table. No claim about the perpetrators is made in this review; any attribution would require source verification.

findings.quote: Shallow comprehension | Mastery of a craft
findings.reason: The batching table implies a strong outcome comparison that the immediately preceding diagram explicitly declines to promise and the following trial-and-adjust instruction treats as individual. Messaging schedules do not by themselves establish mastery.
findings.suggested_correction: Make table cells describe actions or available time: responding to each message versus checking at chosen times, and fragmented task time versus a protected stretch. Remove the shallow-comprehension/mastery row or reframe it as an intended use of time.
findings.verification: Internal inconsistency confirmed; no fresh psychological effect claimed.

findings.quote: The formula doesn't prove what a platform intends or what its feed does to your mind.
findings.reason: The Shannon formula introduces technical burden only to disavow the inference, with no later operational use in this section. Five nearby diagrams repeatedly explain interrupted attention or protected work, and the unbroken figures leave large mid-section blank areas on151 and153. The combined effect stalls the move from a strong scene to usable protocols.
findings.suggested_correction: Consider cutting the entropy equation and retaining its one-sentence boundary. Keep the firewall sequence and the most informative interruption comparison, then assess whether the other diagrams add enough distinct value. If all remain, reduce suitable figure sizes and reflow the spreads. This is an editorial option, not a factual correction.
findings.verification: All relevant full pages viewed in sequence; visual pacing judgment rather than automated whitespace threshold.

findings.quote: None of it waits on anybody's permission.
findings.reason: The immediately preceding controller scene carefully keeps county mixed-use approval and installation review open until answered. The unrestricted sentence about backyard prototypes undercuts that distinction between available tools and permission to deploy them.
findings.suggested_correction: Narrow the sentence to starting inquiry or a lawful trial, for example: You can start learning what these tools do before the whole regional plan is in place.
findings.verification: Internal comparison with the yellow-tab approval sequence. This review does not make a legal determination.

findings.quote: That document is your severance leverage, your consulting practice, or the training data for a tool you own. Unwritten, it's nothing.
findings.reason: The exercise moves from tacit expertise to an owned document or training set without distinguishing an inventory of skills from employer or customer records. It also dismisses the value of unwritten expertise immediately after identifying that expertise as leverage.
findings.suggested_correction: Ask for a nonconfidential inventory of judgment calls, failure modes and skills the reader can describe. Say it can help them show their value or identify work to offer. Replace the final sentence with a claim about making expertise easier to explain, not its being worthless unless written.
findings.verification: Clarity and scope query. Ownership and employment restrictions would need jurisdiction-specific verification before any stronger legal claim.

findings.quote: The copy is worth reading closely
findings.reason: The two archival ads are reproduced so small that their body copy and the coupon are not comfortably readable at the page size. The surrounding prose transcribes some lines, but the invitation to read closely and note the coupon asks more of the reproduction than it supplies.
findings.suggested_correction: Enlarge the ads where page geometry allows or provide a readable transcription of the specific lines being discussed. Preserve source credit and explain if the full image is only a facsimile for context.
findings.verification: Confirmed at full-page120dpi view; fine source-image text may be readable by zooming a digital PDF, but that does not solve normal page-size or printed reading.

findings.quote: one of the largest organized public campaigns ever mounted against a technology
findings.reason: The paragraph carefully labels two million enrollments as the union's own count, then makes a ranking across all campaigns without identifying a comparison set. The cited enrollment figure alone cannot establish the historical superlative.
findings.suggested_correction: Keep the scale and attribution, then call it a major organized campaign, or provide a source that actually establishes the comparison. The argument about the failed preservation of orchestra jobs does not require a largest-ever ranking.
findings.verification: Source verification pending for the comparative claim. Review does not classify the ranking as disproved.

strengths: Rosa delivery scene lets a precise mistake, a correction and ongoing funding carry the argument.
Gary and Sal now have different resources rather than different moral worth; preserve that correction consistently in visuals and later framing.
Controller and Crucible scenes earn competence through repair, approvals, testing and peer accountability.
Research passages generally distinguish illustrative models, forecasts, correlations and measured outcomes more carefully than their opening slogans.
Public-meal discussion admits paid restaurants can close and that British Restaurants charged; it does not manufacture an identical precedent.

mechanical_validation.limitations: Receipt integrity is not proof of editorial judgment. Human-readable page observations and actual view_image calls are the review evidence.
